title: Raku Firing & Potluck Party
bring: bisque-fired work; up to 3 pieces depending on size
summary: Experience instant raku gratification: fire glazed bisque pieces in the raku kiln at 1850°F, then place glowing-red pieces in combustible material for flashing and metallic finishes. Learn glazing, safety, and firing techniques at this potluck event.
evidence_sentence: The event description states participants will fire pieces in the raku kiln and learn raku firing techniques.
evidence_quote: Glazed ceramic pieces are taken out of the raku kiln, glowing red at around 1850 degrees Fahrenheit.
source_quote: Raku Firing & Potluck Party... Thursday, November 12, 5:00pm - 8:00pm... Glazed ceramic pieces are taken out of the raku kiln, glowing red at around 1850 degrees Fahrenheit.
